summary: ADAPTATION consolidation preserved the preceding independent causal maps for every company in Chief batch t0-20260914T0400Z-b01 and deduped their blockers. The batch remains a correlated AI-infrastructure complex rather than 12 independent theses. TSM and ASML remain the strongest domain-ready bottleneck mappings; most others still need substitute/counterfactual evidence. No canonical causal mutation is proposed.
